GitHub

Unopinionated on your data

Any data type, serialized and validated through JSON Schema component schemas.

Layered, not flattened

A dataset is a history of sections. Later edits set, pass through or delete what came before.

ECS at heart

Nodes are ids carrying components, so data is decoupled from the use cases that read it.

Assemblies and types

Parent-child links reuse geometry; native inheritance gives semantic typing.

Edit together ​

Two editors on one car, each its own application with its own copy of the model. Move a part in one and only that change travels to the other, as a small layer on top of what both started from. How it works.

Combine data sources ​
